company.name: ReadCoin
company.description:
ReadCoin is pioneering Web3 platform integrating education, gamification, and a dynamic marketplace to revolutionize the reading experience. We aim to empower readers by incentivizing learning through a Read-to-Earn model, where users earn tokens for engaging with content. 

Read.Earn. Social.

Read. Immerse yourself in a world of books and educational materials while exploring interactive and dynamic content experiences.

Earn. Transform your reading time into rewards with our gamified Read-to-Earn model, allowing you to collect tokens and unlock new opportunities.

Social. Join vibrant social book clubs where readers, writers, and educators connect to share insights, collaborate, and redefine learning.

Collect. Dive into our NFT marketplace to own unique book collectibles that can unlock exclusive content, access new books, and bring an interactive dimension to your reading journey.

Empower. Build a new form of education through tokenized reading, where learning becomes a collaborative, rewarding, and engaging experience for the next generation.

insights.title: Funding is concentrated in the latest major round
insights.statement: The latest disclosed Pre Seed round raised $20,000, or 74.07% of reported total funding.
insights.implication: This round accounts for most reported historical financing, making it important when assessing funding-source concentration and fundraising cadence.

insights.title: Valuation increased across disclosed rounds
insights.statement: Known post-money valuation rose from $222,040 to $410,270, a 1.85x increase.
insights.implication: The disclosed financing history indicates a material valuation step-up between the earliest and latest rounds with known valuations.
caveats: Only rounds with a disclosed post-money valuation are compared.

insights.title: Sharp recent attention and growth momentum
insights.statement: Crunchbase scores growth at 42 (-2 over 90 days) and market heat at 64 (-3).
insights.implication: The company has recently become much more visible, but the scores should be treated as attention/activity indicators rather than revenue or clinical-performance metrics.
caveats: Crunchbase does not expose the complete weighting behind these proprietary scores.

insights.title: Competitive benchmark reflects the modeled peer set
insights.statement: Crunchbase’s closest modeled peers include ReadON, Book.io, Mirror.
insights.implication: These matches provide a starting point for comparing differentiation, scale, and shared specialties, but they should not be treated as a verified competitor set.
